detail.longDescription: My AI SRE said "HIGH confidence" and was wrong: 9 false HIGHs in 57 test investigations. None were hallucinations. A rule in the prompt didn't fix it; structure enforced in code did. Write-up: https:// dev.to/feresberbeche/my-ai-sre -said-high-confidence-and-was-wrong-what-it-took-to-make-high-mean-high-57p6 I'm the founder of AlertiGate, a self-hosted AI SRE for Kubernetes, in free beta: https:// alertigate.com/beta # SRE # Kubernetes # Observability # AIOps
